verses.text: When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.

segments.text: When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion,
We were like unto them that dream.

verses.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.

segments.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter,
Then said they among the nations,
Jehovah hath done great things for them.

verses.text: Jehovah hath done great things for us, Whereof we are glad.

segments.text: Jehovah hath done great things for us,

verses.text: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.

segments.text: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah,
As the streams in the South.

verses.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

segments.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.text: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves with him.

segments.text: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing,
Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves
